biotools.summary: TME-Analyzer is an interactive image analysis tool for interrogating tumor microenvironments, specifically focusing on immune cell distances and their relationship to survival in triple-negative breast cancer patients. The tool identifies predictors of survival and enables interactive visualization of spatial immune phenotypes.
